mechanism_narrative: A positive change in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) over the past month leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, as rising rates compress equity valuations by increasing the discount rate for future cash flows.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in less than 55% of instances where FEDFUNDS increased by more than 0.05 percentage points in the prior month, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A UNRATE above 9.5% indicates a severe recession, triggering aggressive monetary policy and fiscal stimulus that leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as the market anticipates policy support.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in less than 55% of instances where UNRATE > 9.5, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS <= 0.2%) combined with rising consumer price inflation (CPIAUCSL > 215) indicates an inflationary risk-off environment, causing investors to sell equities and seek safe-haven assets, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in less than 55% of instances where FEDFUNDS <= 0.2 and CPIAUCSL > 215, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a recession regime defined by UNRATE > 9.5% and a decline in quarterly GDP growth (GDPC1), the S&P 500 tends to rebound as aggressive monetary and fiscal policy is implemented, leading to positive 60-day forward returns.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE > 9.5 AND GDPC1 decline from previous quarter
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in less than 55% of instances where UNRATE > 9.5 and GDPC1 declines from the previous quarter, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A CPIAUCSL level above 215 indicates persistent inflation, prompting the Federal Reserve to tighten monetary policy, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as investors anticipate rate hikes.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in less than 55% of instances where CPIAUCSL > 215, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A HOUST level below 580 indicates a weakening housing market, which signals a need for monetary easing, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as the market anticipates policy support.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in less than 55% of instances where HOUST < 580, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO < 90) combined with a decline in employment (PAYEMS < 131000) indicates a deepening economic contraction, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as the market prices in further economic deterioration.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in less than 55% of instances where INDPRO < 90 and PAYEMS < 131000, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate at or below 0.2% indicates an ultra-loose monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as investors seek yield in equities.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in less than 55% of instances where FEDFUNDS <= 0.2, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.
